scope: Patch applicability and host mock lifecycle only; not Android target compilation or sensor ABI/runtime verification
fixes: Initialize wrapper/output pointers and reject null output
Do not close/free active vendor on repeated open
Use vendor device pointer for vendor close callback
Vendor owns vendor allocation; wrapper frees its wrapper only
Close opened vendor if wrapper allocation fails
Clear active state on close so reopen works even after close reports error

line_endings.explanation: Upstream sensors source uses CRLF on all151 lines. Sensor hunk retains those line endings for default git apply. Running diff --check on the patch file as text also sees required unified-diff context prefixes before tabs/blank lines as whitespace, so that check is not suitable for embedded diff semantics. The patch instead passes git -c core.whitespace=cr-at-eol apply --check --whitespace=error-all --include=sensors_wrapper/sensorswrapper.c against pinned source.

limitations: Mock headers model only accessed fields; Android headers/linking not validated
Vendor module actual lifecycle/thread safety needs device testing
No runtime claim for proprietary sensors or firmware
